statistical_claim: descriptive finite-pool clustered stress test only
proxy_boundary: The proxy is neither causal, complete, mechanistic, expert-annotated, nor ground truth.
risk_definition: Mean fraction of proxy atoms missed (one minus proxy recall), not the probability of any miss.
atom_occlusion_definition: Zero one atom's continuous features while preserving all molecular edges.

formal_training.device: record actual device; GPU is not a statistical requirement

fragmentation_contract.boundary: The default cap creates a reported structural selection boundary for large or complex molecules and is not raised post hoc.

pair_panel.selection: Deterministic maximum-cardinality molecule-disjoint matching within each target and split; no truncation to preliminary scout counts.
pair_panel.preliminary_scout_boundary: Earlier count estimates were not backed by a recoverable executable artifact and are retained only as a preliminary feasibility estimate.

clustered_calibration.boundary: MMP pairs are clustered inside group_id components. Pair-level exchangeability is unsupported. Neither policy carries a distribution-free pair-level risk-control or generalization guarantee; component-weighted results are also descriptive.

train_development_split.rule: Exact deterministic subset of whole train-only components nearest to 20%; ties favor the smaller development count and seeded component order.
train_development_split.boundary: Whole components are not split to manufacture a 20% development fraction. Development-only early stopping is retained, but extreme component concentration weakens checkpoint selection for these two targets.

target_panel_eligibility.rule: Retain targets with at least 20 auditable molecule-disjoint exact-single-cut cliff pairs in both calibration and test.
target_panel_eligibility.boundary: This is a pre-model feasibility filter and is not relaxed after predictor or attribution results are observed.

cross_target_overlap.boundary: Target-resampling intervals describe this fixed overlapping 11-target panel; they are not population confidence intervals or evidence of independent-target generalization.

negative_control.boundary: The matched noncliff control cannot support causal, specificity, or ground-truth claims.
